findings.description: Mission Control tab system (mc-tab-bar, mc-tab, mc-panel) uses consistent styling across all 4 panels. Tab styling properly handles active/hover states with blue-500 accent (#3d6f9a).
findings.recommendation: No changes needed - styling is consistent

findings.description: Dark theme (#0a0a0a) is correctly applied to textarea backgrounds in mc-panel-body. Modal uses gradient background (rgba(17,17,17,0.97) to rgba(10,10,10,0.99)).
findings.recommendation: No changes needed - dark theme properly applied

findings.description: Tab bar uses gradient background (linear-gradient(180deg, transparent, rgba(0,0,0,0.3))) with border-bottom #222. This creates subtle visual depth but could be more consistent with overall modal styling.
findings.recommendation: OPTIONAL: Consider matching tab-bar border color to modal border (#333) for perfect consistency

findings.description: Team type selector has responsive breakpoint at 500px switching from 4-column to 2-column grid. Mission Control modal is responsive with 95% width and max-width constraints.
findings.recommendation: No changes needed - responsive design handled properly

findings.description: Active tab border-bottom-color is transparent, creating visual connection to panel below. Border-top and sides use #3d6f9a for active state indicator.
findings.recommendation: No changes needed - tab-to-panel connection is visually clean

findings.description: Spawn team button uses gradient (135deg, #3d6f9a to #2d5577) with proper hover states and box-shadow. Consistent with overall blue-500 accent theme.
findings.recommendation: No changes needed - button styling is polished

findings.location: All 4 panels: terminal, commands, feature, team
findings.description: All 4 Mission Control panels (Terminal, Commands, Feature, Team) share consistent mc-panel and mc-panel-body classes with uniform padding (24px), overflow-y: auto, and gap (16px).
findings.recommendation: No changes needed - all panels styled consistently

summary.conclusion: Mission Control styling audit complete. 7/7 checks passed. Only 1 MINOR optional improvement identified (tab-bar border color). Dark theme (#0a0a0a) correctly applied, blue-500 accent (#3d6f9a) consistent throughout, responsive design functional, all 4 panels visually uniform. No critical issues found.
